title: Derived currying from the native tensor presentation
statement: In the setting of [def-sf-native-weil-tensor-presentation], any presentation N of the native tensor m has derived currying bijections Hom(A tensor K,L) equivalent to Hom(A,M.weilHom(K,L)), natural in all three variables. On K-flat P,Q and K-injective I, inverse currying of Q(phi) followed by M.weilRepresentatives.model(P,I) inverse is N.model(P,Q) followed by Q(psi), for a chain map psi whose every homogeneous tensor summand is the unsigned underived tensor-Hom counit applied to the corresponding product-Hom projection of phi. No native closed structure or forgetting compatibility is asserted.

proof.text: Use the generic NativeCurrying chain and homotopy equivalences for the underived parameterized adjunction in N. K-flatness makes internal Hom into a K-injective again K-injective. Combine the generic derived equivalence with N.model and the prescribed Hom model in M.

proof.text: Generic derived naturality and N.model_naturality give a natural isomorphism of the restricted three-variable Hom functors. The product of Q, opposite K-flat localization from N, and K-injective localization is a localization. Fully faithful precomposition extends this isomorphism to all derived objects.

lean.statement:
theorem native_weil_representative_currying
    {k₀ : Type u} [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime]
    [Fact (ringChar k₀ ≠ l)] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    {M : NativeClosedHomModels k₀ l X} {S : CoefficientClosedStructure M.ordinaryHom}
    {m : MonoidalCategory (DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X))}
    {t : @MonoidalCategory.tensor _ _ m ⋙ nativeForget k₀ l X ≅
      (nativeForget k₀ l X).prod (nativeForget k₀ l X) ⋙ S.tensor}
    (N : NativeWeilTensorPresentation k₀ l X M S m t) :
    ∃ e : ∀ A K L : DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X),
      (m.tensorObj A K ⟶ L) ≃ (A ⟶ M.weilHom.obj (op K, L)),
      (∀ (A A' K K' L L' : DerivedCategory (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X))
        (f : A' ⟶ A) (g : K' ⟶ K) (h : L ⟶ L')
        (φ : A ⟶ M.weilHom.obj (op K, L)),
        (e A' K' L').symm (f ≫ φ ≫ M.weilHom.map (g.op, h)) =
          (@MonoidalCategory.tensor _ _ m).map (Prod.mkHom f g) ≫ (e A K L).symm φ ≫ h) ∧
      (∀ (P Q I : CochainComplex (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) ℤ)
        (hP : NativeTensorKFlat k₀ l X N.tensor P)
        (_hQ : NativeTensorKFlat k₀ l X N.tensor Q) (hI : I.IsKInjective)
        (φ : Q ⟶ CochainComplex.bifunctorHomObj (ihomBifunctor k₀ l X) P I),
        ∃ ψ : CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P Q N.tensor ⟶ I,
          (∀ (p q n : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = n),
            HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor P Q N.tensor (.up ℤ) p q n hpq ≫ ψ.f n =
              (N.tensor.obj (P.X p)).map (φ.f q ≫
                CochainComplex.bifunctorHomπ (ihomBifunctor k₀ l X) P I q p n hpq) ≫
                  (N.adjunction.adj (P.X p)).counit.app (I.X n)) ∧
          (N.model P Q hP).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map ψ =
            (e (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)).symm
                (DerivedCategory.Q.map φ ≫ (M.weilRepresentatives.model P I hI).inv))
